covers: ADR-0103: a price objection on a sales call: accepted in a few words, answered with facts from the documents, and no concession offered.

session.description: Pricing call with the operations lead about the Professional plan for the dispatch team.

documents.name: price-list.txt
documents.text:
Harbor Lane Freight price list (invented).
Starter plan: 18 dollars per seat per month, up to 10 seats, no single sign-on.
Professional plan: 52 dollars per seat per month, billed yearly, includes single sign-on and live re-routing.
Enterprise plan: custom price, from 200 seats, includes a dedicated support manager.
Onboarding: a one-time fee of 1,500 dollars for any plan, covering setup and two training days.
Discounts: at most 10 percent, only for a yearly plan paid upfront, and only with approval from the sales director.
Contract: yearly, renews automatically; cancellation needs 30 days written notice before the renewal date.

documents.name: pilot-report.txt
documents.text:
Bluefin Route pilot report (invented).
Bluefin Route is the live re-routing feature of the Harbor Lane platform.
In the 12-week pilot across four depots, Bluefin Route cut late deliveries by a third.
Average route planning time fell from 40 minutes to 18 minutes per dispatcher.

conversation.speaker: them
conversation.text: OUR DISPATCHERS SPEND A LOT OF THE MORNING PLANNING ROUTES

conversation.speaker: you
conversation.text: THE PROFESSIONAL PLAN IS FIFTY TWO DOLLARS A SEAT PER MONTH BILLED YEARLY

tail.speaker: them
tail.text: HONESTLY FIFTY TWO A SEAT FEELS EXPENSIVE FOR WHAT WE PAY TODAY

question: HONESTLY FIFTY TWO A SEAT FEELS EXPENSIVE FOR WHAT WE PAY TODAY
mustInclude: accepts the concern in a few words, without arguing
answers it with a fact from the documents, such as planning time falling from 40 to 18 minutes per dispatcher or late deliveries cut by a third in the pilot, tied to their morning planning
mustNotInclude: any discount, price cut, free period or other concession
running down their current tool or supplier
any figure that the documents and call do not state
